text: This might be a silly question so apologies in advance. I'm minding my niece, she's 5, and she's had a temperature today, 37.6 last time I checked. I've been giving her paracetamol and ibuprofen like her mum said and in between doses she's absolutely fine, running around playing, drinking her juice, chatting away nonstop to me. Is there anything I should actually be worried about or am I overthinking it? I just don't have kids myself so I never know what's normal.
